header_note: IN-PLAY, delivery-level metrics (one sample per delivery, model trained on Season 1, scored on Season 2). These numbers are NOT comparable to the pre-match (P1) or toss-adjusted (P2) metrics: in-play states include near-determined late-innings positions, so delivery-level accuracy/log-loss are structurally more flattering than one-prediction-per-match pre-match scores.
model: src/analytics/win_probability_model.py (LogisticRegression, innings-1 and innings-2 models, state features only)
notes: Delivery-level accuracy counts every delivery as an independent sample although deliveries within a match are highly correlated; treat it as a state-quality diagnostic, not as evidence about pre-match forecasting skill.
